integrity.computation_basis: dependency-free exact-rational verifier covering 18 finite dimension pairs
integrity.proof_basis: analytic facet-and-polarity proof with two exact positive contact-measure certificates

scientific_limitations: The formulas apply to complete bipartite graphs with both part sizes at least two in the standard zero-sum Euclidean edge-coordinate metric, not to every bipartite graph.
The homothety is the equality case in the canonical inner/outer ellipsoid inclusion and is not a claim of optimal arbitrary-linear Banach–Mazur distance.
A search cannot rule out equivalent results under different terminology; independent publication-priority validation has not been conducted.
Finite exact-rational checks corroborate but do not replace the analytic infinite-family proof.
title: Canonical ellipsoids of complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes
